title: Inference engine internals
done when: You can explain prefill vs decode, paged KV cache, continuous batching, and speculative decoding to both a researcher and a customer.

title: Quantization
done when: You can pick a quantization format (FP8, AWQ, GPTQ, NF4, GGUF) for a given GPU and quality bar and say what it does to memory, speed, and accuracy.

title: Inference frameworks across languages
done when: You can place llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, candle, and mistral.rs on the deployment map and say when each is the right tool.

title: Serving and load
done when: You benchmark vLLM and SGLang on the same model, produce TTFT and TPOT vs concurrency curves, and pick a config that meets a stated SLO at the lowest cost per 1M tokens.

title: Serving platforms and reproducibility
done when: You can say which layer (router, gateway, orchestration, managed platform, engine) a customer problem lives in, and why batched inference is not bitwise reproducible by default.
